2026-10-28.text:

2026-10-28.title: Lesson Plan
2026-10-28.text:
00:00 - 00:05 Briefing, whiteboard explanation, and stimulus review
00:05 - 00:12 General warm up
00:12 - 00:21 Strength specific warm up and build to technical weight for Split Jerk
00:21 - 00:34 Strength block: Split Jerk every 1:30 x 5 (7.5 minutes)

2026-10-28.title: Warm up
2026-10-28.text:
**General Warm Up (Approx. 7 Minutes)**
EMOM 6 (2 Rounds):
Min 1: 40 sec Single Unders / DU Attempts
Min 2: 10 PVC Pass Throughs + 5 PVC Push Press + 10 Scapular Push Ups
Min 3: 10 Box Step Ups + 10 Band Pull Aparts
1:00 Wrists Warm Up

**Specific Warm Up - Split Jerk**
With A PVC, All Together (Coach Counting):
5 Dip And Drives
5 Push Press
10 Jumps Into Split Position With Bar In Front Rack
5 Split Jerks With A 2 Second Hold In The Split Position
Build To Technical Weight In 2-3 Sets Of 3
Beginners: Push Press / Push Jerk

**Specific Warm Up - Metcon**
2 Rounds:
3 HSPU Or Scaling Option (Kipping Practice / Pike Push Ups)
4 Dual DB Front Rack Box Step Ups (Build To Workout Weight)
20 DU
Beginners: Elevated Push Ups, Box Step Ups, Single Unders

2026-10-28.title: Metcon:
2026-10-28.text:
5 RFT:
10 HSPU
10 Dual DB Front Rack Box Step ups @2x22,5/15 kg @50 cm for all
50 DU

TC: 13

BEGINNER:
5 RFT:
8 Elevated Push ups
8 Box Step ups
40 SU

TC: 13

2026-10-28.text:

2026-10-29.title: FBB
2026-10-29.text:
**Block A:**

3 Sets:
6/6 Single Arm DB Floor Press With a 2 Sec Pause @Heavy
8/8 Cossack Squats Holding a KB In Goblet @Moderate

rest 1:30

**Block B:**

3 Sets:
6/6 Skater Squats (Back Knee Touches A Mat)
10/10 Single Arm DB Row With A 2 Sec Hold @Moderate
10/10 Half Kneeling Pallof Press With A 3 Sec Hold

rest 1:30

**Block C:**

3 Sets:
10 Seated DB Z Press With A 3 Sec Lowering @Light
10 Hamstring Curls On Rower
20/20 m Suitcase Carry @Heavy

rest 1:30

2026-10-29.text:
A) 90/90 Knee 
10 reps Side to side

B) 90/90 Hip Internal and External Rotation
10 reps each ex. each side

1:00 Each Side

2026-10-29.title: Back Squat - Intencity
2026-10-29.text:
Week 9:

Build in 5–7 sets to a 2-rep set @ 100%
All sets must be done as sets of 2 reps.
Do 1 set every 3 minutes.

אפשרי לשים חגורה בסטים מעל 90 %

2026-10-29.text:
Week 2:

Strict HSPU:
4 sets of 4-8 reps @2-3 RIR 

rest 1:30

Eccentric Kipping HSPU ( add 5-10 kg plates for deficit if it feels too nice )
4 sets:
3-6 reps @3 sec on the way down

rest  1:30 

*1:30 rest between the sets and between the parts

2026-10-29.text:

3 Kip Swings + 1-2 BMU / 3 C2B / 3 PU / 3 Jumping PU
